SELECT p.*, u.user_name AS userName, s.name AS supplierName FROM t_purchase_list p LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_supplier s ON p.supplier_id = s.id
${ew.sqlSegment}

SELECT pl.purchase_number AS "number", TO_CHAR(pl.purchase_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date",
pl.supplier_id AS "name",
plg.code AS "code", plg.name AS "goodsName", plg.model AS "model",
gt.name AS "typeName",
plg.price AS "price", plg.num AS "num", plg.unit AS "unitName", plg.total AS "total"
FROM t_purchase_list pl
LEFT JOIN t_purchase_list_goods plg ON pl.id = plg.purchase_list_id
LEFT JOIN t_goods_type gt ON plg.type_id = gt.id
AND plg.name LIKE '%' || #{goodsName} || '%'
AND plg.type_id = #{typeId}
AND pl.purchase_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND pl.purchase_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
